claims.allowed_only_if: The identical port (O4.P11, RUN-CONSOLE-PORT-IDENTICO-001) is delivered and rendering this project's own sources.
claims.current_reason: The prototype under console/ was retired by D-048 and the port has not run. Today the only console that renders is Cantu's, over Cantu's data.

claims.allowed_only_if: The parity run (O4.P5, RUN-CONSOLE-PARIDAD-RENDER-CANTU-001) is delivered with operator QA.
claims.current_reason: Parity is a verified result, not a side effect of the port; nothing has verified it.

claims.claim: The full set of console sources is emitted
claims.allowed_only_if: The nine deferred sources gain an emitter and enter through the normal door of CONTRATO §18.b, one by one.
claims.current_reason: Measured: of the twelve sources without an emitter, only three buy live pixels (docs index and the two governance tables) and only those three are emitted. The other nine are deferred and are not stubbed.

claims.claim: What is emitted under .project/ is schema-validated
claims.allowed_only_if: A validator for the contract folder exists and runs over the emitted files.
claims.current_reason: The capa-3 validator does not exist. The validator that does exist belongs to Cantu, checks .aiw/ and its own literals, and never reads this folder.

claims.claim: aiw-console is a verbatim fork of the JAME console
claims.current_reason: The audit compared the bytes and measured that they are not a verbatim copy: the console here was copied from Cantu's before Cantu retired its legacy roadmap, and the projector was added on top. The phrase survived only as stale self-description in package.json, which RUN-CONSOLE-STALE-TEXTS-REPAIR-001 removed.
